cases.chart_zh: 患者男性, 78岁, 因腰背部疼痛 3 月, 加重 1 周入院。既往: 骨质疏松病史 5 年, 原发性高血压 10 年, 2 型糖尿病 5 年。查体: T12 棘突压痛叩痛阳性, 下肢肌力 5 级。MRI: T12 椎体压缩性骨折, 椎体高度丢失约 40%。入院诊断: T12 椎体压缩性骨折。行 T12 椎体切开复位内固定术, 手术顺利。术后给予抗骨质疏松药物治疗, 腰背支具佩戴。术后 7 天出院, 切口愈合良好。
cases.chart_en: 78-year-old male admitted with lower back pain for 3 months, worsened for 1 week. History: osteoporosis for 5 years, essential hypertension for 10 years, type 2 diabetes for 5 years. Exam: T12 spinous process tenderness and percussion pain positive, lower extremity muscle strength 5/5. MRI: T12 vertebral compression fracture, approximately 40% height loss. Admission diagnosis: T12 vertebral compression fracture. Underwent T12 open reduction and internal fixation, surgery uneventful. Postoperatively given anti-osteoporosis medication and lumbar brace. Discharged on day 7, incision healing well.

cases.chart_zh: 患者女性, 32岁, 转移性右下腹痛 1 天, 伴恶心呕吐 2 次。查体: T 38.5℃, McBurney 点压痛反跳痛阳性, Rovsing 征阳性。WBC 14.2, 中性 88%。腹部 CT: 阑尾肿胀, 周围渗出, 未见穿孔。入院诊断: 急性单纯性阑尾炎。行腹腔镜阑尾切除术, 手术顺利。术后病理: 急性单纯性阑尾炎, 浆膜层未累及。术后恢复良好, 第 3 天出院。
cases.chart_en: 32-year-old female with migrating right lower quadrant pain for 1 day, accompanied by nausea and vomiting twice. Exam: T 38.5C, McBurney point tenderness and rebound tenderness positive, Rovsing sign positive. WBC 14.2, neutrophils 88%. Abdominal CT: swollen appendix with surrounding exudate, no perforation seen. Admission diagnosis: acute simple appendicitis. Underwent laparoscopic appendectomy, surgery uneventful. Postoperative pathology: acute simple appendicitis, serosa not involved. Recovered well, discharged on day 3.

cases.chart_zh: 患者男性, 64岁, 咳嗽咳痰伴发热 3 天入院。胸片示右下肺浸润影。WBC 14.5, 中性 82%, PCT 0.5, CRP 65。CURB-65 评分 1 分。痰培养: 肺炎链球菌。既往: 2 型糖尿病 10 年, 吸烟史 30 年。入院诊断: 社区获得性肺炎 (CAP, PSI 中危)。予头孢曲松 + 阿奇霉素经验性治疗, 7 天后症状好转出院。
cases.chart_en: 64-year-old male admitted with productive cough and fever for 3 days. Chest X-ray shows right lower lobe infiltrate. WBC 14.5, neutrophils 82%, PCT 0.5, CRP 65. CURB-65 score 1. Sputum culture: Streptococcus pneumoniae. History: type 2 diabetes for 10 years, 30 pack-year smoking. Admission diagnosis: community-acquired pneumonia (CAP, PSI intermediate risk). Started on ceftriaxone and azithromycin empirically, symptoms improved and discharged after 7 days.

cases.chart_zh: 患者女性, 56岁, 多饮多尿伴乏力 2 周, 加重伴恶心呕吐 1 天入院。既往: 2 型糖尿病 8 年, 服用二甲双胍 + 格列美脲。查体: 嗜睡, 呼吸深快, 口腔黏膜干燥。血糖 28.5 mmol/L, pH 7.20, HCO3- 12 mmol/L, 尿酮 3+, 尿糖 4+。HbA1c 9.8%。入院诊断: 2 型糖尿病性酮症酸中毒。予小剂量胰岛素静脉滴定 + 补液 + 监测电解质, 36 小时后酮体转阴, 改皮下胰岛素。住院 7 天, 出院时血糖控制可。
cases.chart_en: 56-year-old female with polydipsia, polyuria, and fatigue for 2 weeks, worsened with nausea and vomiting for 1 day. History: type 2 diabetes for 8 years, on metformin and glimepiride. Exam: drowsy, deep and rapid breathing, dry oral mucosa. Blood glucose 28.5 mmol/L, pH 7.20, HCO3- 12 mmol/L, urine ketone 3+, urine glucose 4+. HbA1c 9.8%. Admission diagnosis: type 2 diabetic ketoacidosis. Given low-dose insulin IV titration + fluid resuscitation + electrolyte monitoring, ketones cleared after 36 hours, switched to subcutaneous insulin. Hospitalized for 7 days, blood glucose well-controlled at discharge.

cases.chart_zh: 患者男性, 58岁, 持续性胸骨后压榨样疼痛 2 小时入院。疼痛向左肩放射, 伴大汗、恶心。既往: 原发性高血压 12 年, 高脂血症 5 年, 吸烟史 25 年。查体: BP 90/60, HR 110, 双肺底湿啰音。心电图: II, III, aVF ST 段抬高 0.3 mV, V1-V4 镜像压低。肌钙蛋白 I 8.5 ng/mL (参考 < 0.04)。入院诊断: 急性下壁 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死 (STEMI, Killip II 级)。急诊行 PCI + 药物涂层支架植入 (右冠状动脉近段 100% 闭塞 → TIMI 3 级血流恢复)。术后胸痛缓解, 心电图 ST 段回落。
cases.chart_en: 58-year-old male with persistent substernal crushing pain for 2 hours. Pain radiates to left shoulder, accompanied by diaphoresis and nausea. History: essential hypertension for 12 years, hyperlipidemia for 5 years, 25 pack-year smoking. Exam: BP 90/60, HR 110, bibasilar moist rales. ECG: II, III, aVF ST elevation 0.3 mV, V1-V4 reciprocal depression. Troponin I 8.5 ng/mL (reference < 0.04). Admission diagnosis: acute inferior ST-elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI, Killip class II). Emergency PCI + drug-eluting stent implantation (proximal right coronary artery 100% occlusion → TIMI 3 flow restored). Postoperative chest pain relieved, ECG ST segment returned to baseline.
